summary: PIMCO Dynamic Income Fund filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $3.0 billion of common shares through JonesTrading Institutional Services LLC as sales agent, replacing a prior ATM program. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Terms disclose a 1.10% management fee on average daily total managed assets and leverage via reverse repurchase agreements averaging 31.92% of managed assets at a 4.53% weighted average cost. Watch distribution rate, NAV premium/discount, and leverage-driven dilution risk.
